title: Style Palette
description: A named style's whitelist of survival-obtainable Minecraft block IDs, injected into the trial prompt as the binding material constraint (spec §6) and read by the palette-adherence validator (spec §9). The `blocks` array is the single source of truth; `groups` is an optional advisory view over it.

id.description: Kebab-case style identifier, unique across palettes (e.g. "industrial", "art-deco").

minecraftVersion.description: The Minecraft (Java) version the block IDs are valid against, e.g. "1.20.4". Block IDs are version-dependent, so this makes "valid block ID" a decidable check.

description.description: One-line prompt-facing statement of the style's material intent.

blocks.description: The whitelist: the canonical, authoritative set of allowed block types. Bare Minecraft block IDs (no `minecraft:` prefix), unique, non-empty.

groups.description: Optional advisory grouping of `blocks` for human and prompt legibility (e.g. structure / metal / glazing). Every block listed in any group MUST also appear in `blocks` — groups organize the canonical set, they never extend it. This subset invariant is enforced by validate.mjs.
